QUOTE: The lookup tables are not hand-written. `scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans every `include/mbedtls/*.h` for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_xxx -0x....` lines. ... It then emits one `case` per code into `library/error.c`, using `scripts/data_files/error.fmt` as the template.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/error.c is generated from the public headers by scripts/generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template.
